messages:
jamie (People Ops): Heads up — new hire Priya (Khan-Patel) starts Mon, remote (CET). Passport shows dual citizenship (US + IN). Anyone know if remote I-9 via notary is OK for this case?

sophia (Hiring Manager): She mentioned passport expiring in ~2 months but still valid on start date. Workday has her name as 'Khan Patel' (no hyphen) — could that cause a bg/name mismatch?

jamie (People Ops): Passport + SSN card should be acceptable for I-9 as long as docs are unexpired. The hyphen vs space can trigger BG flags — we should match whichever is on passport for the I-9 and update Workday after verification.

mike (IT): Badge/laptop order needs the exact name for shipping and access provisioning. Can we lock name before we print?

jamie (People Ops): Proposal: 1) Schedule remote notary session Tue 09:00 CET, 2) Priya uploads scanned passport + SSN to the secure intake portal, 3) People Ops updates Workday once notary confirms identity. Anyone object?

people-ops-bot: Created checklist: /onboarding/checklists/1748001234-priya-notary-checklist — items: secure upload, notary appt, Workday update, BG re-run if mismatch. (link: https://redwood.ops/internal/onboard/1748001234)

notary-service: We can do remote notarization via DocuSign/NotaryNow. Requirements: government ID with photo, live video call, company pays $35 notarization fee. We'll email a booking link once you confirm timezone and contact phone.

Sophia (Hiring Manager): Re reimburse — please CC finance for fee. Also benefits 101 is at 10:00 PT that day (we usually run at 10am PT). That's 18:00 CET — can we have a live Q&A at 18:15 CET and record the session? Priya prefers a live slot.

jamie (People Ops): Yes, will request 18:15 CET live Q&A and record. Also sending pre-enrollment benefits form now so she can pick tiers early.

mike (IT): Shipping note: Priya is located in London — laptop shipping 3–5 business days to the address in her profile. Confirmed we can deliver before start if label created today.

Sophia (Hiring Manager): Confirmed address in DM. I also told Priya to expect a short name-check call from People Ops to confirm spellings.

jamie (People Ops): Great. I'll book notary slot Tue 09:00 CET and ping everyone once booked. If the BG system still flags name mismatch after the notary, we'll run manual review with BG vendor. Any objections?

Sophia (Hiring Manager): :thumbsup:

mike (IT): 👍 will hold laptop provisioning until final name confirmation.

people-ops-bot: Reminder set: notary booking follow-up + Workday update (due: 1748080000).
